History of Bombay Stock Exchange
The American Civil War in 1861 disrupted cotton export to Britain, turning their focus to India for raw materials, which led to the rise of India's first "Cotton King," Premchand Roychand.
The end of the Civil War caused a market crash, leading to Roychand's bankruptcy. Despite this, he became a philanthropist, notably funding the Premchand Roychand Scholarship at Calcutta University and the iconic Rajabai Tower in Mumbai.
